confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on search snippets from mixed-age sources (crowdsourced Expatistan figures, a 2024 Expat Exchange guide, and travel-budget sites) that disagree by up to about 2x. Cocktail and wine_glass are partly inferred: the cocktail uses an Expatistan downtown-club point, and the wine glass uses the draft-beer relationship and a retail bottle price because no per-glass bar price was found. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was run. FX uses the RBA 15 Oct 2026 observation of 0.6955 from the RBA overview page. Search summaries also reported 0.6947 for 16 Oct on the statistics page, but that page's metadata was inconsistent, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Montevideo-specific food and drink price points, placed within a Latin American capital price range. An Expatistan comparison title putting Montevideo about 37% above Sofia was used only as a loose sanity check.
